scenes.title: Berry by the Stream
scenes.body: A little fox and a small bear met by a bouncy stream. They shared a handful of wild berries and laughed as the water made soft gurgles. Right away, they felt like friends.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: A Windy Path
scenes.body: A bouncy wind blew leaves across the path, hiding the way home. The fox and the bear did not worry. Together, they lifted a fallen branch and made a little bridge over a muddy puddle. Tip-toe, thump-thump, they crossed side by side.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: Home and Honey
scenes.body: On the other side, the sun came out and the bear found a jar of honey by a tree stump. They dipped apple slices in it and shared every bite. "Friends help friends," said the fox, and the bear nodded with a sticky smile. Then they walked home together as the stars peeked out.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about friendship.
